AVX-512 unit test macros, static checks, and compile-time expansion helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines shared test helpers for AVX-512 unit tests. It includes compile-time checks for `WW_WIDTH`, `WW_FOOTPRINT`, `WW_ALIGN`, and related log values, so the test code can verify the expected vector layout before use. The macros `WWI_TEST`, `WWU_TEST`, `WWL_TEST`, `WWV_TEST`, and `WWB_TEST` store SIMD values to arrays and compare each lane against expected data, then call `FD_LOG_ERR` if any lane does not match. The file also defines `EXPAND_4`, `EXPAND_16`, `EXPAND_32`, `EXPAND_64`, `COMPARE8`, and `COMPARE16` to help build tests that need compile-time constant arguments and repeated comparisons.
